name: zh-core
description: Chinese business correspondence. Smaller than the Japanese and English sets on purpose: Chinese is the secondary target, and its personal-name rule is known to be weak. The set exists to stop the pack regressing and to quantify the trade-off rather than to claim the language is solved. Every name, number and identifier is invented.

samples.annotated: 尊敬的[[PERSON:张伟]]先生，请拨打[[PHONE:13812345678]]与我们联系。
请联系[[PERSON:李明]]经理，邮箱是[[EMAIL:liming@example.com]]。
合作方是[[COMPANY_NAME:北京云图科技有限公司]]。
这是[[COMPANY_NAME:北京云图科技有限公司]]的[[PERSON:张伟]]。
samples.note: The company rule must not swallow the leading 这是 or the trailing name.

samples.annotated: 身份证号[[RESIDENT_ID:11010519491231002X]]，请妥善保管。

samples.note: Negative: eighteen digits with a failing check character.

samples.annotated: 编号 100081 的物料已入库。
samples.note: Negative: six bare digits without the postcode label.

samples.annotated: 地址：[[ADDRESS:北京市海淀区中关村大街1号]]
出生日期: [[DATE_OF_BIRTH:1985-04-01]]，工号: [[EMPLOYEE_ID:A-12345]]
交货日期是 2026-03-31，请安排验收。
项目名称: [[PROJECT_NAME:夜莺]] 进展顺利。
各位女士，欢迎参加本次说明会。
samples.note: Negative: polite address, not a name.

samples.annotated: 发给[[COMPANY_NAME:王氏集团]]处理即可。
samples.note: An organisation, not a person. 王 is a surname, so the name rule must stand aside for the company rule.

samples.annotated: 我下周去江苏省出差。
samples.note: Negative: a province, not a person.

samples.annotated: 收到消息我很高兴，方便的时候请回复。
samples.note: Negative: 高兴 and 方便 both begin with a surname character. This is the case the LOW-confidence rule exists to survive.

samples.annotated: 负责人是[[PERSON:张伟]]，请知悉。
samples.note: Dictionary-anchored: no honorific to lean on.

samples.annotated: 作者是[[PERSON:欧阳修]]，宋代人。
密码: [[PASSWORD:huiyi2026chun]]，请及时修改。
内网文档在[[INTERNAL_URL:https://wiki.corp.local/zh]]。
已确认，明天之前处理完毕。
samples.note: Negative: a whole reply with nothing to protect.

samples.annotated: [[PERSON:王强]]女士与[[PERSON:陈静]]老师都会出席。

尊敬的[[PERSON:诸葛云]]先生：
本次评审由[[PERSON:诸葛云]]主持，请在会前把材料发给[[PERSON:诸葛云]]。
samples.note: Co-occurrence. In Chinese this is not an optimisation -- there is nothing else to anchor the later mentions on.

samples.annotated:
合同方为[[COMPANY_NAME:云图科技有限公司]]。
